question: Which praised, hidden, and protective epithets of the deity are saluted in this mantra verse?
premises: The deity is addressed as praised.
The deity is addressed as hidden.
The deity is addressed as lord of cowherds and receives repeated obeisance.
inference: The mantra offers repeated obeisance to the praised, hidden lord of cowherds.
plain_english: Obeisance to the praised one, the hidden one, the lord of cowherds; obeisance, obeisance.
